Q1.en: A quadratic polynomial has degree 2, and a polynomial of degree \(n\) has at most \(n\) zeroes. So a quadratic polynomial has at most 2 zeroes, which is the choice 2.
Q1.hi: द्विघात बहुपद की घात 2 होती है और घात \(n\) वाले बहुपद के अधिक से अधिक \(n\) शून्यक होते हैं। अतः द्विघात बहुपद के अधिक से अधिक 2 शून्यक होंगे, जो विकल्प 2 है।

Q2.en: Dividing repeatedly by primes, \(36 = 2 \times 18 = 2 \times 2 \times 9 = 2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3\). So \(36 = 2^2 \times 3^2\), which is the choice \(2^2 \times 3^2\).
Q2.hi: अभाज्य संख्याओं से बार-बार भाग देने पर \(36 = 2 \times 18 = 2 \times 2 \times 9 = 2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3\)। अतः \(36 = 2^2 \times 3^2\), जो विकल्प \(2^2 \times 3^2\) है।

Q3.en: For two numbers, \(\text{HCF} \times \text{LCM} = \) product of the numbers. So \(\text{LCM} = \frac{26 \times 91}{13} = 2 \times 91 = 182\), which is the choice 182.
Q3.hi: दो संख्याओं के लिए म. स. \(\times\) ल. स. = संख्याओं का गुणनफल। अतः ल. स. \(= \frac{26 \times 91}{13} = 2 \times 91 = 182\), जो विकल्प 182 है।

Q4.en: \(150 = 2 \times 3 \times 5^2\) and \(210 = 2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 7\). The common prime factors are 2, 3 and 5, so \(\text{HCF} = 2 \times 3 \times 5 = 30\), which is the choice 30.
Q4.hi: \(150 = 2 \times 3 \times 5^2\) तथा \(210 = 2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 7\)। उभयनिष्ठ अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2, 3 और 5 हैं, अतः HCF \(= 2 \times 3 \times 5 = 30\), जो विकल्प 30 है।

Q5.en: Since \(-a\) is a zero, \(p(-a) = 0\): \(2a^2 + 2a(-a) + 5(-a) + 10 = 0\), that is \(2a^2 - 2a^2 - 5a + 10 = 0\). So \(5a = 10\) and \(a = 2\), which is the choice 2.

Q6.en: Putting \(a = 6\): \(\frac{6}{3} - \frac{b}{4} = 1\), so \(2 - \frac{b}{4} = 1\), \(\frac{b}{4} = 1\) and \(b = 4\), which is the choice 4.

Q7.en: \((x + 6)(x - 5) = 0\) gives \(x + 6 = 0\) or \(x - 5 = 0\), so \(x = -6\) or \(x = 5\). The roots are \(-6\), 5, which is the choice \(-6\), 5.

Q8.en: From a point outside a circle exactly two tangents can be drawn to the circle, so the number of tangents is 2, which is the choice 2.
Q8.hi: वृत्त के बाहर स्थित किसी बिंदु से वृत्त पर ठीक दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ खींची जा सकती हैं, अतः स्पर्श रेखाओं की संख्या 2 है, जो विकल्प 2 है।

Q9.en: Since \(DE \parallel BC\), \(\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC\) (their corresponding angles are equal), so \(\frac{AD}{AB} = \frac{DE}{BC}\). Here \(AB = AD + DB = 2.1 + 4.2 = 6.3\) cm, so \(BC = \frac{DE \times AB}{AD} = \frac{3.1 \times 6.3}{2.1} = 3.1 \times 3 = 9.3\) cm, which is the choice 9.3 cm.
Q9.hi: चूँकि \(DE \parallel BC\), अतः \(\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC\) (संगत कोण बराबर हैं), इसलिए \(\frac{AD}{AB} = \frac{DE}{BC}\)। यहाँ \(AB = AD + DB = 2.1 + 4.2 = 6.3\) सेमी, अतः \(BC = \frac{DE \times AB}{AD} = \frac{3.1 \times 6.3}{2.1} = 3.1 \times 3 = 9.3\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 9.3 सेमी है।

Q11.en: \(\sec^2 A = 1 + \tan^2 A = 1 + \frac{49}{576} = \frac{625}{576}\), so \(\sec A = \frac{25}{24}\) (the angle is acute, so \(\sec A > 0\)), which is the choice \(\frac{25}{24}\).

Q12.en: \(\tan 45^\circ = 1\), so the value is \(\frac{2 \times 1}{1 + 1^2} = \frac{2}{2} = 1\), which is the choice 1.

Q13.en: \(\sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A \cdot \cot A = \frac{1}{\cos A} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin A} \cdot \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{\sin^2 A} = \operatorname{cosec}^2 A\), which is the choice \(\operatorname{cosec}^2 A\).
Q13.hi: \(\sec A \cdot \operatorname{cosec} A \cdot \cot A = \frac{1}{\cos A} \cdot \frac{1}{\sin A} \cdot \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{1}{\sin^2 A} = \operatorname{cosec}^2 A\), जो विकल्प \(\operatorname{cosec}^2 A\) है।

Q14.en: Since \(1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta\), \(\frac{1}{1 + \tan^2\theta} = \cos^2\theta\). So the value is \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\), which is the choice 1.
Q14.hi: चूँकि \(1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta\), अतः \(\frac{1}{1 + \tan^2\theta} = \cos^2\theta\)। अतः मान \(\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1\) है, जो विकल्प 1 है।

Q15.en:
**Note:** The English print gives the angle as \(30^\circ\) and the Hindi print as \(60^\circ\); the working follows the English print, and with \(60^\circ\) the arc would be 22 cm.
Arc length \(l = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r = \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 = \frac{1}{12} \times 132 = 11\) cm, which is the choice 11 cm.
Q15.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न में कोण \(30^\circ\) और हिंदी प्रश्न में \(60^\circ\) छपा है; हल अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न (\(30^\circ\)) के अनुसार है, और \(60^\circ\) लेने पर चाप की लंबाई 22 सेमी होगी।
चाप की लंबाई \(l = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r = \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 21 = \frac{1}{12} \times 132 = 11\) सेमी, जो विकल्प 11 सेमी है।

Q16.en: Joining two cubes of side 4 cm end to end gives a cuboid of length 8 cm, breadth 4 cm and height 4 cm. Its total surface area is \(2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(8 \times 4 + 4 \times 4 + 4 \times 8) = 2(32 + 16 + 32) = 160\) cm\(^2\), which is the choice 160 cm\(^2\).
Q16.hi: 4 सेमी भुजा के दो घनों को मिलाने पर लंबाई 8 सेमी, चौड़ाई 4 सेमी और ऊँचाई 4 सेमी का घनाभ बनता है। इसका सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(8 \times 4 + 4 \times 4 + 4 \times 8) = 2(32 + 16 + 32) = 160\) सेमी\(^2\) है, जो विकल्प 160 सेमी\(^2\) है।

Q17.en: A well shuffled pack of 52 playing cards has no joker, so drawing a joker is an impossible event and its probability is \(\frac{0}{52} = 0\). None of the given choices is 0. If the question meant a jack (a pack has 4 jacks), the probability would be \(\frac{4}{52} = \frac{1}{13}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{13}\).
Q17.hi: अच्छी प्रकार से फेंटे गए 52 पत्तों की गड्डी में कोई जोकर नहीं होता, अतः जोकर निकलना एक असंभव घटना है और इसकी प्रायिकता \(\frac{0}{52} = 0\) है। दिए गए विकल्पों में कोई भी 0 नहीं है। यदि प्रश्न का आशय गुलाम (जैक) से हो (गड्डी में 4 गुलाम होते हैं), तो प्रायिकता \(\frac{4}{52} = \frac{1}{13}\) होगी, जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{13}\) है।

Q18.en: The empirical relation is \(\text{mode} = 3\,\text{median} - 2\,\text{mean}\), so \(2\,\text{mean} = 3\,\text{median} - \text{mode}\) and \(\text{mean} = \frac{3\,\text{median} - \text{mode}}{2}\). Hence \(R = 2\), which is the choice 2.
Q18.hi: आनुभविक संबंध \(\text{बहुलक} = 3\,\text{मध्यक} - 2\,\text{माध्य}\) है, अतः \(2\,\text{माध्य} = 3\,\text{मध्यक} - \text{बहुलक}\) और \(\text{माध्य} = \frac{3\,\text{मध्यक} - \text{बहुलक}}{2}\)। अतः \(R = 2\), जो विकल्प 2 है।

Q19.en: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. The highest frequency is 10, for the class 30 - 35, so the modal class is 30 - 35, which is the choice 30 - 35.
Q19.hi: बहुलक वर्ग वह वर्ग है जिसकी बारंबारता सबसे अधिक हो। सबसे अधिक बारंबारता 10 है, जो वर्ग 30 - 35 की है, अतः बहुलक वर्ग 30 - 35 है, जो विकल्प 30 - 35 है।

Q20.en: Two dice give \(6 \times 6 = 36\) equally likely outcomes. A sum of 7 comes from (1, 6), (2, 5), (3, 4), (4, 3), (5, 2), (6, 1), that is 6 outcomes. So the probability is \(\frac{6}{36} = \frac{1}{6}\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{6}\).

B1a.en:
Simplify each side separately.
LHS \(= \frac{1 + \sec A}{\sec A} = \frac{1 + \frac{1}{\cos A}}{\frac{1}{\cos A}} = \frac{\cos A + 1}{\cos A} \times \cos A = 1 + \cos A\)
RHS \(= \frac{\sin^2 A}{1 - \cos A} = \frac{1 - \cos^2 A}{1 - \cos A} = \frac{(1 - \cos A)(1 + \cos A)}{1 - \cos A} = 1 + \cos A\)
Since LHS = RHS, \(\frac{1 + \sec A}{\sec A} = \frac{\sin^2 A}{1 - \cos A}\). Hence proved.
B1a.hi:
दोनों पक्षों को अलग-अलग सरल करते हैं।
बायाँ पक्ष \(= \frac{1 + \sec A}{\sec A} = \frac{1 + \frac{1}{\cos A}}{\frac{1}{\cos A}} = \frac{\cos A + 1}{\cos A} \times \cos A = 1 + \cos A\)
दायाँ पक्ष \(= \frac{\sin^2 A}{1 - \cos A} = \frac{1 - \cos^2 A}{1 - \cos A} = \frac{(1 - \cos A)(1 + \cos A)}{1 - \cos A} = 1 + \cos A\)
चूँकि बायाँ पक्ष = दायाँ पक्ष, अतः \(\frac{1 + \sec A}{\sec A} = \frac{\sin^2 A}{1 - \cos A}\)। इति सिद्धम्।

B1b.en:
The area of a sector of angle \(\theta\) is \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2\). Here \(r = 14\) cm and \(\theta = 30^\circ\).
Area \(= \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{1}{12} \times 616 = \frac{154}{3} \approx 51.33\) cm\(^2\)
So the area of the sector is \(\frac{154}{3}\) cm\(^2\), about 51.33 cm\(^2\).
B1b.hi:
कोण \(\theta\) वाले त्रिज्याखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2\) होता है। यहाँ \(r = 14\) सेमी और \(\theta = 30^\circ\)।
क्षेत्रफल \(= \frac{30^\circ}{360^\circ} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 14 \times 14 = \frac{1}{12} \times 616 = \frac{154}{3} \approx 51.33\) सेमी\(^2\)
अतः त्रिज्याखंड का क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{154}{3}\) सेमी\(^2\), अर्थात लगभग 51.33 सेमी\(^2\) है।

B1c.en:
Suppose, on the contrary, that \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) is rational. Then \(5 + \sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{b}\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are integers and \(b \neq 0\).
Then \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{b} - 5 = \frac{a - 5b}{b}\).
Since \(a\) and \(b\) are integers, \(\frac{a - 5b}{b}\) is rational, so \(\sqrt{3}\) would be rational. But \(\sqrt{3}\) is irrational. This contradiction arises from the wrong assumption.
Hence \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) is an irrational number.
B1c.hi:
इसके विपरीत मान लीजिए कि \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) परिमेय है। तब \(5 + \sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{b}\), जहाँ \(a\) और \(b\) पूर्णांक हैं तथा \(b \neq 0\)।
तब \(\sqrt{3} = \frac{a}{b} - 5 = \frac{a - 5b}{b}\)।
चूँकि \(a\) और \(b\) पूर्णांक हैं, अतः \(\frac{a - 5b}{b}\) परिमेय है, अर्थात \(\sqrt{3}\) परिमेय होगा। परंतु \(\sqrt{3}\) अपरिमेय है। यह विरोधाभास हमारी गलत कल्पना के कारण है।
अतः \(5 + \sqrt{3}\) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।

B1d.en:
The mid-point of the segment joining \((x_1, y_1)\) and \((x_2, y_2)\) is \(\left(\frac{x_1 + x_2}{2}, \frac{y_1 + y_2}{2}\right)\).
Here it is \(\left(\frac{2 + (-7)}{2}, \frac{-2 + 4}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{-5}{2}, \frac{2}{2}\right)\).
So the mid-point is \(\left(-\frac{5}{2}, 1\right)\).
B1d.hi:
बिंदुओं \((x_1, y_1)\) और \((x_2, y_2)\) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य बिंदु \(\left(\frac{x_1 + x_2}{2}, \frac{y_1 + y_2}{2}\right)\) होता है।
यहाँ मध्य बिंदु \(\left(\frac{2 + (-7)}{2}, \frac{-2 + 4}{2}\right) = \left(\frac{-5}{2}, \frac{2}{2}\right)\)।
अतः मध्य बिंदु के निर्देशांक \(\left(-\frac{5}{2}, 1\right)\) हैं।

B2a.en:
Let the first term be \(a\) and the common difference \(d\). The \(n\)th term is \(a_n = a + (n - 1)d\), so \(a_{17} = a + 16d\) and \(a_{10} = a + 9d\).
Given \(a_{17} - a_{10} = 7\):
\((a + 16d) - (a + 9d) = 7\)
\(7d = 7\)
\(d = 1\)
So the common difference is 1.

B2c.en:
When two dice are thrown together, the total number of equally likely outcomes is \(6 \times 6 = 36\).
A sum less than 7 means a sum of 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6:
Sum 2: (1, 1)
Sum 3: (1, 2), (2, 1)
Sum 4: (1, 3), (2, 2), (3, 1)
Sum 5: (1, 4), (2, 3), (3, 2), (4, 1)
Sum 6: (1, 5), (2, 4), (3, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1)
Number of favourable outcomes \(= 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 15\)
Required probability \(= \frac{15}{36} = \frac{5}{12}\)

B2d.en:
A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact, so \(\angle OBA = \angle OCA = 90^\circ\).
The angles of the quadrilateral \(ABOC\) add up to \(360^\circ\):
\(\angle BAC + 90^\circ + 110^\circ + 90^\circ = 360^\circ\), so \(\angle BAC = 70^\circ\).
In \(\triangle OAB\) and \(\triangle OAC\): \(OB = OC\) (radii), \(OA\) is common and \(\angle OBA = \angle OCA = 90^\circ\), so the triangles are congruent (RHS). Hence \(\angle OAB = \angle OAC = \frac{1}{2}\angle BAC = \frac{70^\circ}{2} = 35^\circ\).
So \(\angle OAB = 35^\circ\).
B2d.hi:
स्पर्श बिंदु पर स्पर्श रेखा त्रिज्या पर लंब होती है, अतः \(\angle OBA = \angle OCA = 90^\circ\)।
चतुर्भुज \(ABOC\) के कोणों का योग \(360^\circ\) है:
\(\angle BAC + 90^\circ + 110^\circ + 90^\circ = 360^\circ\), अतः \(\angle BAC = 70^\circ\)।
\(\triangle OAB\) और \(\triangle OAC\) में: \(OB = OC\) (त्रिज्याएँ), \(OA\) उभयनिष्ठ है और \(\angle OBA = \angle OCA = 90^\circ\), अतः दोनों त्रिभुज सर्वांगसम हैं (RHS)। अतः \(\angle OAB = \angle OAC = \frac{1}{2}\angle BAC = \frac{70^\circ}{2} = 35^\circ\)।
अतः \(\angle OAB = 35^\circ\)।

B2e.en:
Let the sides \(AB\), \(BC\), \(CD\) and \(DA\) touch the circle at \(P\), \(Q\), \(R\) and \(S\) respectively.
The lengths of the two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal. Therefore
\(AP = AS\) (tangents from the point \(A\))
\(BP = BQ\) (tangents from the point \(B\))
\(CR = CQ\) (tangents from the point \(C\))
\(DR = DS\) (tangents from the point \(D\))
Adding these,
\(AP + BP + CR + DR = AS + BQ + CQ + DS\)
\((AP + BP) + (CR + DR) = (AS + DS) + (BQ + CQ)\)
\(AB + CD = AD + BC\)
Hence proved.
B2e.hi:
माना भुजाएँ \(AB\), \(BC\), \(CD\) और \(DA\) वृत्त को क्रमशः \(P\), \(Q\), \(R\) और \(S\) पर स्पर्श करती हैं।
किसी बाह्य बिंदु से वृत्त पर खींची गई दोनों स्पर्श रेखाओं की लंबाइयाँ बराबर होती हैं। अतः
\(AP = AS\) (बिंदु \(A\) से स्पर्श रेखाएँ)
\(BP = BQ\) (बिंदु \(B\) से स्पर्श रेखाएँ)
\(CR = CQ\) (बिंदु \(C\) से स्पर्श रेखाएँ)
\(DR = DS\) (बिंदु \(D\) से स्पर्श रेखाएँ)
इन्हें जोड़ने पर
\(AP + BP + CR + DR = AS + BQ + CQ + DS\)
\((AP + BP) + (CR + DR) = (AS + DS) + (BQ + CQ)\)
\(AB + CD = AD + BC\)
इति सिद्धम्।

B2f.en:
Make the cumulative frequency table.

| Class interval | Frequency \(f\) | Cumulative frequency \(cf\) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 - 10 | 6 | 6 |
| 10 - 20 | 10 | 16 |
| 20 - 30 | 14 | 30 |
| 30 - 40 | 10 | 40 |
| 40 - 50 | 8 | 48 |

Here \(n = 48\), so \(\frac{n}{2} = 24\). The cumulative frequency just greater than 24 is 30, so the median class is 20 - 30.
\(l = 20\), \(cf = 16\), \(f = 14\), \(h = 10\)
Median \(= l + \left(\frac{\frac{n}{2} - cf}{f}\right) \times h = 20 + \frac{24 - 16}{14} \times 10 = 20 + \frac{80}{14} = 20 + 5.71 = 25.71\) (approximately)
So the median is about 25.71 (exactly \(\frac{180}{7}\)).

B3a.en:
Let the base be \(x\) cm. Then the altitude is \((x - 7)\) cm, and the hypotenuse is 13 cm.
By Pythagoras theorem,
\(x^2 + (x - 7)^2 = 13^2\)
\(x^2 + x^2 - 14x + 49 = 169\)
\(2x^2 - 14x - 120 = 0\)
\(x^2 - 7x - 60 = 0\)
\(x^2 - 12x + 5x - 60 = 0\)
\((x - 12)(x + 5) = 0\)
So \(x = 12\) or \(x = -5\). A length cannot be negative, so \(x = 12\).
Base \(= 12\) cm and altitude \(= 12 - 7 = 5\) cm.
Check: \(12^2 + 5^2 = 144 + 25 = 169 = 13^2\).
So the other two sides are 12 cm and 5 cm.

B3b.en:
Let one number be \(x\). Since the sum is 27, the other number is \(27 - x\).
Their product is 182:
\(x(27 - x) = 182\)
\(27x - x^2 = 182\)
\(x^2 - 27x + 182 = 0\)
\(x^2 - 13x - 14x + 182 = 0\)
\(x(x - 13) - 14(x - 13) = 0\)
\((x - 13)(x - 14) = 0\)
So \(x = 13\) or \(x = 14\).
If \(x = 13\), the other number is \(27 - 13 = 14\); if \(x = 14\), the other is 13.
Check: \(13 + 14 = 27\) and \(13 \times 14 = 182\).
So the two numbers are 13 and 14.

B4a.en:
Write everything in terms of \(\tan A\), using \(\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}\).
LHS \(= \frac{\tan A}{1 - \frac{1}{\tan A}} + \frac{\frac{1}{\tan A}}{1 - \tan A}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^2 A}{\tan A - 1} + \frac{1}{\tan A(1 - \tan A)}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^2 A}{\tan A - 1} - \frac{1}{\tan A(\tan A - 1)}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^3 A - 1}{\tan A(\tan A - 1)}\)
Using \(a^3 - b^3 = (a - b)(a^2 + ab + b^2)\),
\(= \frac{(\tan A - 1)(\tan^2 A + \tan A + 1)}{\tan A(\tan A - 1)}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^2 A + \tan A + 1}{\tan A}\)
\(= \tan A + 1 + \cot A\)
Now \(\tan A + \cot A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A}{\sin A \cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} = \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A\).
So LHS \(= 1 + \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A =\) RHS. Hence proved.
B4a.hi:
\(\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}\) का प्रयोग करके सब कुछ \(\tan A\) में लिखते हैं।
बायाँ पक्ष \(= \frac{\tan A}{1 - \frac{1}{\tan A}} + \frac{\frac{1}{\tan A}}{1 - \tan A}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^2 A}{\tan A - 1} + \frac{1}{\tan A(1 - \tan A)}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^2 A}{\tan A - 1} - \frac{1}{\tan A(\tan A - 1)}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^3 A - 1}{\tan A(\tan A - 1)}\)
\(a^3 - b^3 = (a - b)(a^2 + ab + b^2)\) से,
\(= \frac{(\tan A - 1)(\tan^2 A + \tan A + 1)}{\tan A(\tan A - 1)}\)
\(= \frac{\tan^2 A + \tan A + 1}{\tan A}\)
\(= \tan A + 1 + \cot A\)
अब \(\tan A + \cot A = \frac{\sin A}{\cos A} + \frac{\cos A}{\sin A} = \frac{\sin^2 A + \cos^2 A}{\sin A \cos A} = \frac{1}{\sin A \cos A} = \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A\)।
अतः बायाँ पक्ष \(= 1 + \sec A \operatorname{cosec} A =\) दायाँ पक्ष। इति सिद्धम्।

B4b.en:
Given \(\sec\theta + \tan\theta = P\), so \(P = \frac{1}{\cos\theta} + \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{1 + \sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\).
Squaring,
\(P^2 = \frac{(1 + \sin\theta)^2}{\cos^2\theta} = \frac{(1 + \sin\theta)^2}{1 - \sin^2\theta} = \frac{(1 + \sin\theta)^2}{(1 - \sin\theta)(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{1 + \sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta}\)
Then
\(P^2 - 1 = \frac{1 + \sin\theta - (1 - \sin\theta)}{1 - \sin\theta} = \frac{2\sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta}\)
\(P^2 + 1 = \frac{1 + \sin\theta + 1 - \sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta} = \frac{2}{1 - \sin\theta}\)
Dividing,
\(\frac{P^2 - 1}{P^2 + 1} = \frac{2\sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta} \times \frac{1 - \sin\theta}{2} = \sin\theta\)
So \(\sin\theta = \frac{P^2 - 1}{P^2 + 1}\). Hence proved.
B4b.hi:
दिया है \(\sec\theta + \tan\theta = P\), अतः \(P = \frac{1}{\cos\theta} + \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{1 + \sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\)।
वर्ग करने पर
\(P^2 = \frac{(1 + \sin\theta)^2}{\cos^2\theta} = \frac{(1 + \sin\theta)^2}{1 - \sin^2\theta} = \frac{(1 + \sin\theta)^2}{(1 - \sin\theta)(1 + \sin\theta)} = \frac{1 + \sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta}\)
तब
\(P^2 - 1 = \frac{1 + \sin\theta - (1 - \sin\theta)}{1 - \sin\theta} = \frac{2\sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta}\)
\(P^2 + 1 = \frac{1 + \sin\theta + 1 - \sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta} = \frac{2}{1 - \sin\theta}\)
भाग देने पर
\(\frac{P^2 - 1}{P^2 + 1} = \frac{2\sin\theta}{1 - \sin\theta} \times \frac{1 - \sin\theta}{2} = \sin\theta\)
अतः \(\sin\theta = \frac{P^2 - 1}{P^2 + 1}\)। इति सिद्धम्।

B5a.en:
The capsule is a cylinder with a hemisphere at each end. The diameter is 5 mm, so the radius is \(r = \frac{5}{2} = 2.5\) mm.
The whole length 14 mm includes the two hemispheres, each of length \(r\). So the length of the cylindrical part is \(h = 14 - 2 \times 2.5 = 9\) mm.
Surface area of the capsule = curved surface area of the cylinder + curved surface areas of the two hemispheres
\(= 2\pi rh + 2 \times 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi r(h + 2r)\)
\(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times (9 + 5)\)
\(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times 14\)
\(= 220\) mm\(^2\)
So the surface area of the capsule is 220 mm\(^2\).
B5a.hi:
कैप्सूल एक बेलन है जिसके दोनों सिरों पर एक-एक अर्धगोला लगा है। व्यास 5 मी.मी. है, अतः त्रिज्या \(r = \frac{5}{2} = 2.5\) मी.मी.।
पूरी लंबाई 14 मी.मी. में दोनों अर्धगोले शामिल हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक की लंबाई \(r\) है। अतः बेलनाकार भाग की लंबाई \(h = 14 - 2 \times 2.5 = 9\) मी.मी.।
कैप्सूल का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल + दोनों अर्धगोलों के वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल
\(= 2\pi rh + 2 \times 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi r(h + 2r)\)
\(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times (9 + 5)\)
\(= 2 \times \frac{22}{7} \times 2.5 \times 14\)
\(= 220\) मी.मी.\(^2\)
अतः कैप्सूल का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 220 वर्ग मी.मी. है।

B5b.en:
Height of the cylinder and of the cone \(h = 2.4\) cm, radius \(r = \frac{1.4}{2} = 0.7\) cm.
Slant height of the cone \(l = \sqrt{r^2 + h^2} = \sqrt{0.49 + 5.76} = \sqrt{6.25} = 2.5\) cm.
The remaining solid has three surfaces: the curved surface of the cylinder, the one circular base of the cylinder that is left, and the curved surface of the conical cavity.
Total surface area \(= 2\pi rh + \pi r^2 + \pi rl = \pi r(2h + r + l)\)
\(= \frac{22}{7} \times 0.7 \times (2 \times 2.4 + 0.7 + 2.5)\)
\(= 2.2 \times (4.8 + 0.7 + 2.5)\)
\(= 2.2 \times 8 = 17.6\) cm\(^2\)
So the total surface area of the remaining solid is 17.6 cm\(^2\), which is 18 cm\(^2\) to the nearest cm\(^2\).
B5b.hi:
बेलन तथा शंकु की ऊँचाई \(h = 2.4\) सेमी, त्रिज्या \(r = \frac{1.4}{2} = 0.7\) सेमी।
शंकु की तिर्यक ऊँचाई \(l = \sqrt{r^2 + h^2} = \sqrt{0.49 + 5.76} = \sqrt{6.25} = 2.5\) सेमी।
शेष ठोस के तीन पृष्ठ हैं: बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ, बेलन का बचा हुआ एक वृत्ताकार आधार, और शंक्वाकार खोल का वक्र पृष्ठ।
सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(= 2\pi rh + \pi r^2 + \pi rl = \pi r(2h + r + l)\)
\(= \frac{22}{7} \times 0.7 \times (2 \times 2.4 + 0.7 + 2.5)\)
\(= 2.2 \times (4.8 + 0.7 + 2.5)\)
\(= 2.2 \times 8 = 17.6\) सेमी\(^2\)
अतः शेष ठोस का सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 17.6 सेमी\(^2\) है, जो निकटतम वर्ग सेमी तक 18 सेमी\(^2\) है।
